1538. BST Minimum Difference

80

Hard

Problem Statement:
Given the root of a Binary Search Tree, find the minimum absolute difference between values of any two nodes. In a Binary Search Tree (BST), you need to find the minimum difference between any two nodes' values. Construct the BST from given input and return the smallest absolute difference.
input_spec:
and return the smallest absolute difference.

Input Description:
First line contains an integer n - number of nodes. Second line contains n space-separated integers to be inserted into BST.
output_spec: Print a single integer denoting the minimum absolute difference.
